name: Permits & Licensing Committee Special Meeting
minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  September 19, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900 -6833,
meeting ID: 864 4151 6669 and Password 472919 on September 19, 2024, at 2:01 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Angel Leon - Martell, Planning Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department – 2:02 pm
  Cpt. Reginald Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Jazmine Covington, Emergency Service Department

  Staff Present:  Angela Allen, City Clerk’s Office
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Marsha Teskete on behalf of Lavender Blue Group to host a Rams VIP Tailgate
  Event at 3883 W. Century Blvd,Hollywood Park Casino, Private Property, on
  Sundays, and one Thursday, September 22, 2024, October 6, 2024, October 20,
  2024; Thursday, October 24, 2024; November 11, 2024, November 24, 2024,
  December 8, 2024, and December 29, 2024, from 8:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval for
  8 time event (September-December 2024) within Hollywood Park Casino parking lot;
  Applicant to hire a minimum 5 professional licensed security guards for the safety of
  attendees;must wear reflective vests; Security managed and monitored by
  Hollywood Park Casino Security Director, Barry Shapiro; security must screen for
  contraband-weapons; security staff must monitor the entire event area to ensure NO
  underage alcohol possession / consumption. NO more than 300 guests at this
  event;NO gang attire; Must adhere to all IMC regulations. Conditions for amplified
  sound: Manage noise reading; Comply with IMC 5-27 and IMC 5-29; beverage
  service area established Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event
  shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing
  safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
   department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00385281)

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Adjournment
